name: How long does it take to install soft close drawer slides?

mainEntity.name: How long does it take to install soft close drawer slides?

acceptedAnswer.text: The time required to install soft close drawer slides varies based on the number of drawers and the complexity of the installation. For a typical kitchen with 10-15 drawers, a professional installation can often be completed within one to two days. Retrofitting existing drawers may take slightly longer per drawer due to potential adjustments or modifications. New cabinet installations generally integrate the slides more quickly.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time depends on the number of drawers and complexity; a typical kitchen can take one to two days.
